_common: Photorealistic wide editorial photograph, natural daylight, shot on a full-frame camera at eye level, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, Southern California home. An appliance repair technician (navy polo shirt with no logo or text, work pants) is working on the machine. Absolutely NO logos, brand names, badges, letters or readable text anywhere on the appliance, the clothes, the tools or the room; control panels show only plain icons and blank displays. Keep the left third of the frame calm and uncluttered. No watermark.
samsung-washer: A modern Samsung-style front-load washing machine in a dark 'brushed black' finish with a large dark-tinted round door and a sleek touch control panel with a small digital display, in a bright modern laundry room with white shaker cabinets. The technician kneels beside it with the door open, inspecting the rubber door gasket with a flashlight; a small open toolbox on the tile floor.
samsung-dryer: A modern Samsung-style front-load electric dryer in a dark 'brushed black' finish with a large dark round door and a minimalist touch panel, standing in a contemporary laundry room with light wood shelves. The technician has the lower front kick panel removed and is testing a component with a digital multimeter; panel and screws placed neatly on a towel on the floor.
whirlpool-washer: A white top-load washing machine in classic American Whirlpool style — tall white cabinet, glass lid, rotary dial and a row of buttons on a rear console — in a suburban laundry room with a utility sink. The technician leans over the open lid, lifting out the agitator; replacement part and screwdriver on top of the machine.
whirlpool-dryer: A white front-load electric dryer in classic American Whirlpool style — white cabinet, round chrome-rimmed door, rear console with a rotary dial — next to a matching washer in a family laundry room. The technician kneels and pulls the lint screen housing area apart, a shop vacuum hose and a new drive belt beside him.
ge-washer: A GE-style white top-load washing machine with a clean white cabinet, glass lid and a rear console with a large knob and a few buttons, in a garage laundry area with a pegboard wall. The technician has the cabinet front tilted open and is checking the drain pump with a flashlight; a bucket and towels on the concrete floor.
ge-dryer: A GE-style dryer in a 'diamond gray' metallic finish with a front-load round door and a rear control console, in a laundry closet with louvered doors opened wide. The technician is on one knee replacing the heating element — the back access panel is off and a new coiled heating element lies on a towel.
maytag-washer: A heavy-duty Maytag-style top-load washing machine, white with a sturdy commercial look, big rotary dial on a rear console and a robust lid, in a utility room with a concrete floor and wire shelving. The technician is replacing the lid switch assembly, holding the part, with a cordless drill and nut drivers on the machine.
maytag-dryer: A heavy-duty Maytag-style electric dryer, white with a large square-ish door and a big rotary dial on the rear console, in a basement-style laundry room. The technician is checking the dryer vent connection at the back, the machine pulled out from the wall, a roll of foil tape and a vent brush on the floor.
amana-washer: A budget white top-load washing machine in Amana style - plain white cabinet, solid white lid, simple rotary dial on a low rear console - in a small apartment laundry nook. A young Latino technician with short black hair has the console tilted back and is replacing the lid switch; screwdriver and new part on top of the machine.
amana-dryer: A basic white electric dryer in Amana style with a simple square door and one big rotary dial, in a garage next to the water heater. A middle-aged technician with a gray beard has the front panel off and is installing a new thermal fuse, holding it in his fingers; parts tray on the concrete floor.
asko-washer: A compact Scandinavian ASKO-style 24-inch front-load washer in brushed stainless steel with a minimalist control strip, installed under a white quartz counter in a modern condo. A technician with a shaved head kneels and removes the bottom service plate to clear the drain pump filter; a shallow tray catching water.
asko-dryer: A compact Scandinavian ASKO-style stainless-steel front-load dryer stacked on top of a matching washer inside a narrow closet with sliding doors fully open. A technician on a small step stool cleans the condenser area with a soft brush; minimalist white walls.
beko-washer: A compact European-style white front-load washer with a chrome door ring, Beko style, in a small townhouse utility room with gray tile. A young technician with curly hair sits on his heels and replaces the rubber door boot seal, the old seal on the floor beside him.
beko-dryer: A compact white heat-pump front-load dryer, Beko style, under a laundry counter in a modern apartment. A technician kneels and pulls out the lint filter and heat-exchanger drawer at the bottom, rinsed filter on a towel beside him.
blomberg-washer: A 24-inch European white front-load washer, Blomberg style, in a hallway laundry closet of a Santa Monica condo, bi-fold doors open. A technician pulls the machine slightly forward and checks the water inlet hoses with a flashlight; new hoses coiled on the floor.
blomberg-dryer: A compact 24-inch ventless white front-load dryer, Blomberg style, stacked on a matching washer in a bright condo laundry closet. The technician, on a step stool, removes the condensate water container and inspects the pump; a small tool roll on a shelf.
bosch-washer: A 24-inch Bosch-style white front-load washer with a large round chrome-ring door and a clean blue-white display, installed under a kitchen counter in a modern West Hollywood condo. A technician kneels and opens the lower access flap to clean the drain pump filter, towel and shallow pan under it.
bosch-dryer: A Bosch-style compact white front-load condensation dryer with a silver door ring, stacked on a matching washer in a laundry closet with white cabinets. A technician on a step stool examines the door seal and condenser area with a flashlight.
electrolux-washer: A premium front-load washer in a dark titanium finish with a chrome door ring and a luxury control panel, Electrolux style, on a pedestal in a large modern laundry room with marble counters. A technician kneels and replaces the door lock assembly, door open, part in hand.
electrolux-dryer: A premium front-load dryer in a dark titanium finish with a chrome door ring on a pedestal, Electrolux style, in an upscale laundry room with herringbone floor. The technician has the top panel lifted and is replacing a drum support roller; neatly arranged tools on a microfiber cloth.
fisher-paykel-washer: A modern top-load washing machine with a glass lid and stainless-steel lid frame, Fisher and Paykel style, minimalist control strip at the back, in a Scandinavian-style laundry room with light oak. A technician leans over and lifts out the wash basket to reach the motor; new part on the counter.
fisher-paykel-dryer: A white front-load dryer with a large round door, Fisher and Paykel style, next to a top-load washer, in a light minimalist laundry room. A technician on one knee checks the moisture sensor bars inside the drum with a multimeter.
frigidaire-washer: A white front-load washer in Frigidaire style with a simple silver control panel, in a Long Beach apartment laundry closet. A young Black technician with a neat beard pulls the machine out from the wall to check the drain hose and standpipe; flashlight in hand.
frigidaire-dryer: A white front-load electric dryer in Frigidaire style in a suburban laundry room with a window. A technician has the back panel off and is testing the heating element terminals with a multimeter; new element in its box on the floor.
haier-washer: A compact 24-inch white front-load washer, Haier style, in a small studio apartment closet. A young Asian technician kneels and checks the drum bearing by rocking the drum, door open, flashlight clipped to his shirt pocket.
haier-dryer: A compact ventless white dryer, Haier style, on a stacking kit above a compact washer in a small apartment. The technician on a step stool cleans the lint duct with a long flexible brush.
hotpoint-washer: A basic white top-load washer with a tall center agitator, Hotpoint style, with a simple two-dial rear console, in the laundry room of an older Inland Empire house with linoleum floor. A middle-aged technician replaces the agitator dogs, the agitator lifted out and placed on a towel.
hotpoint-dryer: A basic white electric dryer, Hotpoint style, with a simple rotary dial, in a garage laundry corner. The technician has the top lifted open and is installing a new drive belt around the drum; old frayed belt on the floor.
kenmore-washer: A classic white top-load washer, Kenmore style, with a rear console of knobs, in a 1970s-era house laundry room with wood paneling. An older technician with gray hair and reading glasses checks the water inlet valve at the back with a flashlight.
kenmore-dryer: A classic white gas dryer, Kenmore style, with a rear console and a big dial, in a garage of a Riverside home, gas line and flexible connector visible behind. The technician kneels with the lower front panel off and replaces the igniter in the burner assembly.
kitchenaid-washer: A premium KitchenAid-style front-load washer in a polished dark stainless finish with a large chrome-framed door, on a pedestal drawer in a high-end Orange County laundry room with white shaker cabinets. A technician kneels and replaces the drain pump through the lower access panel.
kitchenaid-dryer: A premium KitchenAid-style front-load dryer in dark stainless with a large chrome-framed door on a pedestal, beside its matching washer, in an upscale laundry room. The technician unscrews the control panel to replace the control board; antistatic bag with the new board on the counter.
midea-washer: A modern white front-load washer with a dark tinted door and a digital touch display, Midea style, in a newly built Irvine townhouse laundry closet. A young technician with a ponytail kneels and runs a diagnostic test on a tablet, door open.
midea-dryer: A modern white front-load dryer with a dark tinted door, Midea style, stacked on a matching washer in a newly built townhouse. A technician on a step stool replaces the door switch, small parts in a magnetic tray.
miele-washer: A German Miele-style white compact front-load washer with a large chrome porthole door and a minimalist white control panel, under a counter in a high-end Beverly Hills laundry room. A technician wearing latex gloves inspects the honeycomb-pattern stainless drum with a flashlight.
miele-dryer: A German Miele-style white compact heat-pump dryer with a chrome porthole door, stacked on a matching washer in an elegant laundry room with stone floors. A technician pulls out the plinth filter at the bottom and rinses it in a small basin.
speed-queen-washer: A rugged Speed Queen-style top-load washing machine with a white cabinet, heavy stainless lid and a metal console with mechanical knobs, in a small laundromat-style laundry room with several machines. A technician with tattooed forearms swaps the transmission seal, the machine tilted back on wooden blocks.
speed-queen-dryer: A rugged Speed Queen-style white electric dryer with a large door and mechanical dials, in a utility room of a small apartment building. The technician cleans out the vent duct behind the dryer with a vent brush, lint collected in a bag.
